spans.s:
प्याट् ind. A particle of calling
(ho!, holla).

प्याय् {c1c} A. (प्यायते, प्यान or पीन)
To swell, grow; see प्यै below,
प्यान a. Fat, grown fat; cf. पीन.

प्यायन a.
1 Invigorating.
--2
Promoting strength or growth.
--नं
Increase, growth.

प्यायित a.
1 Grown, increased.
--2 Grown fat.
--3 Refreshed,
strengthened.
